name: Development process
description: A task from your words: an agent names it, works in a git worktree from dev until the tests pass, you try it on a dev stand, and it is merged into dev, one task at a time.

permissions.statuses:register: Adds Testing, Review, Merging and In dev.
permissions.steps:register: Adds the steps of the development process.
permissions.processes:run: Continues a task's process when its agent says it is done and when dev is free again.
permissions.tasks:write: Names the task, keeps its refined description and points its agents at the worktree.
permissions.agents:spawn: Runs the agent that names the task and the one that does the work, sends it test failures and your comments, and ends it before its worktree is removed.
permissions.workspaces:resolve: Restores a task's worktree, removed after the merge, when you continue its agent.
